newsitem.title: GERMANY: Toothbrush triggers bomb scare in sorting office.
newsitem.headline: Toothbrush triggers bomb scare in sorting office.

text.p: Authorities evacuated around 100 staff from a postal sorting office in Hennigsdorf near Berlin on Saturday after an envelope began emitting noises that suggested it could be a letter bomb, police said on Sunday.
A police bomb disposal squad X-rayed the package and then opened it to reveal the contents as a battery-operated toothbrush which had accidentally been swItched on in transit.
